project: Ingest Cutover to WDK (Feature-Flagged) + Retire Ingest Jobs (0003b)
overview: Cut over document ingest execution from legacy durable jobs to WDK workflow/step execution behind a short-lived feature flag. When enabled, uploads start a WDK ingest workflow and do not create jobs(type=ingest_document). Quick Start run execution cutover is tracked separately in refactor 0004.
goals: WDK owns document ingest execution when cutover flag is enabled.
Ingest execution is safe to retry at the step boundary without duplicating durable side effects.
Dev UX is preserved (optional inline kick is acceptable, but must be WDK-based when WDK is enabled).
Legacy ingest jobs path is deletable after rollout.
nonGoals: Change PDF extraction behavior (still pdfjs-dist text extraction; no OCR/geometry in this slice).
Cut over Quick Start run execution (handled in refactor 0004).
successMetrics: With FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=1, uploads ingest via WDK and no ingest job rows are created.
Worker restart mid-ingest completes without duplicate durable writes.

routes.name: Upload document
routes.purpose: When FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=1, uploads start WDK ingest workflow. When disabled, legacy jobs enqueue remains.

uiNotes: No new UI required; behavior is triggered by existing upload flow.
rules: Cutover is controlled by a single env flag (FEATURE_WDK_INGEST).
Rollback must not require schema rollback; schema changes must be additive/compatible.
When FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=1, uploads create an ingest_document run row and start WDK workflow execution with input { run_id }.
When cutover is enabled, do not silently fall back to legacy jobs execution.

stories.title: Feature-flagged ingest uses WDK workflow execution
stories.description: As a developer, I want ingest to be runnable via WDK behind a flag so we can cut over safely and roll back quickly if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce a single env flag FEATURE_WDK_INGEST to choose orchestration path (jobs vs WDK).
Example: with FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=1, uploads start WDK ingest workflow and do not enqueue jobs(type=ingest_document).
Example: with FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=1, uploads create a runs row with type=ingest_document so ingest progress is durable and debuggable in runs/run_steps.
Negative: with FEATURE_WDK_INGEST unset/0, ingest still works via legacy jobs without requiring a WDK worker.

stories.title: WDK ingest step is idempotent at the step boundary
stories.description: As an operator, I want retries to not duplicate durable writes so worker restarts do not corrupt state.
acceptanceCriteria: WDK ingest schedules a deterministic step_key per document ingest execution so retries and restarts do not duplicate work.
Example: kill the worker mid-ingest and restart it; ingest completes and does not create duplicate (document_id, page_number) rows.
Negative: repeated retries must not leave the document in a permanently inconsistent state or multiply chunks/pages.

stories.title: Legacy ingest jobs path is deletable after rollout
stories.description: As a contributor, I want the legacy ingest jobs path to be explicitly removable once the flag is rolled forward so dual runtimes do not linger.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide a roll-forward checklist and then delete legacy ingest job enqueue + handler references once default is WDK.
Example: after rollout, there are no remaining references to jobs(type=ingest_document) in code.
Negative: there is no silent fallback that reintroduces jobs runtime for ingest when WDK is enabled.

automated: Unit tests verifying FEATURE_WDK_INGEST selects the correct enqueue path and that WDK-enabled path does not call legacy enqueue.
manualSmoke: Upload a PDF; confirm ingest completes and no ingest job row is created
Kill worker mid-ingest; restart; confirm completion without duplicate durable writes
FEATURE_WDK_INGEST=0 and confirm legacy ingest works without WDK worker
